page.overview:
Who is Mortal Kombat Film: A Character Guide?

Mortal Kombat, the new film based on the lore of the franchise of the same name, hit theaters and streaming on HBO Max on April 23, 2021. Critics have praised the film's grounded approach with plenty of the gore the series is famous for, and fans are excitedly watching what seems to be most faithful movie interpretation of the franchise to date. But with so many characters to keep track of, you may be feeling a bit lost if you're just joining in, and it's no surprise that even regulars may want a bit of a refresher. Fandom is here to help with our spoiler-free guide to all of the major characters featured in the new film. With the aid of the Mortal Kombat Wiki's bureaucrat, Riley Heligo, we'll be giving you a look both at how they fit into the film itself, as well as a summary of their place within the overall franchise. So kick back, kick some ass, and get over here as we delve into the characters of the 2021 Mortal Kombat film...

You can visit here to see the full listing of characters (warning - may contain spoilers). If you haven't already, visit here for our guide to locations and lore, and be sure to check out Mortal Kombat, now in wide release to theaters, or in the comfort of your own home on HBO Max.
